name: index-options-grid-qqq-2-3-har-vix-gate
notes: ADR-0187 cell qqq-2-3: QQQ condors 2-3 calendar days to settlement, label horizon 2 sessions, chain read within 0.07 log-moneyness, 15 yearly validation folds from 2011-01-01, embargo 10 days. The har-vix rung: generated from run-real-har-vix.json (index-options-real-har-vix) by index_options.grid.grid_document, so edit the base rung or the grid table and rewrite with write_grid, never this file. Needs a pulled ./ob holding optionshist-chain (index_daily + option_chain) and cboe-index (VIX). Never decision-eligible. ADR-0194 entry-gate study, annotate-only, added by index_options.grid.gate_study_document to the document described above: the same forecasts, chain and trades, plus two nodes. vix3m reads the Cboe VIX3M closes and signals (index_options.nodes.VolRegimeSignals) gives every forecast row the PREVIOUS session's VIX / VIX3M ratio and its expanding percentile, the previous session's variance premium ((VIX/100)^2 less annualized realized variance) and four boolean gates: the curve inverted (ratio >= 1.0), the ratio in its own top tail (percentile >= 0.8), a non-positive premium, and any of them; an input that is missing gives null, never false. The backtest reads those rows and, per book and gate, reports the traded P&L where the gate was closed (it would have stood aside), open, or unknown: no entry is skipped, so the metrics say what standing aside would have removed, not what a gated strategy earns. The lag is one session, so the 16:15 ET VIX close never informs a 16:00 ET entry. Needs the store to hold what the description above needs plus cboe-index-wide (VIX3M; register and backfill configs/source-cboe-index-wide.json). ADR-0196 volatility-scaled sizing study, annotate-only, added by index_options.grid.sizing_study_document to the document described above: the same forecasts, chain and trades, plus one node. sizing (index_options.nodes.VolSizingWeights) gives every forecast row three weights from the PREVIOUS session's VIX and realized vol against the expanding median of the sessions before it: size_inv_implied_var (median VIX^2 over today's, sell less after high implied variance), size_inv_realized_var (the same on realized variance) and size_implied (VIX over its median, the opposite bet: sell more after high VIX), each clipped to [0.25, 4.0] and null before 252 earlier sessions or on a missing input. The backtest reads those rows and, per book and weight, reports the traded P&L as if each trade had been taken at that many contracts (total, per unit of weight, t, CVaR, drawdown): no entry is skipped and no trade changes, so the metrics say what sizing would have done, not what a sized strategy earns. The literature conflicts (cutting exposure after high volatility helps equity factors, and mostly not in real time; higher VIX has paid put writers), hence two directions. Run: python -m dskit.pipeline walkforward configs/grid/qqq-2-3-gate.json --asof <today>.

underlying.notes: QQQ raw daily closes with each ex-date's dividend_amount (the optionshist index_daily stream, ADR-0187). since_ms is 2000-03-21 UTC midnight: the first row after the last split, because raw prices are the strike basis and the reader refuses a flagged split.

vix.notes: VIX closes, keyed by date in vix_by_date for the join.

vix_by_date.notes: dskit keyby: {date: VIX close}, the side table the join reads (one close per date; a repeated date refuses).

market.notes: Same-date VIX close as iv_index for every underlying: VXN and RVX start only in 2009-09, and the S&P 500's implied vol is the proxy scale feature (ADR-0187); the implied book prices from each underlying's own chain iv instead. A date VIX lacks keeps iv_index null.

rv.notes: HAR-style daily/weekly/monthly realized vol, backward-only. rv_22 is the reference scale; all three are inputs for a later HAR rung.

labels.notes: ln(S_t+h / S_t) over h = 2 sessions, the bucket's label horizon (the sessions its lower DTE bound spans, ADR-0187); the embargo covers its calendar reach. Rows whose horizon runs past the data keep a null label.

fwd.notes: Realized per-step vol over the same 2 sessions as the label: the target a scale rung regresses on. Every rung of a cell shares this pipeline.

model.notes: log-HAR plus log VIX (HAR-IV, Busch/Christensen/Nielsen 2011): tests whether realized-vol history adds to the implied scale.

vix3m.notes: VIX3M daily closes from the wide Cboe source (cboe-index-wide; the history starts 2007-12): the three-month VIX, the far end of the curve the gate compares the VIX to. Read only by signals.

signals.notes: Adds the term ratio, its percentile, the variance premium and the four gates to every model row, each read from the PREVIOUS session (lag_sessions 1). Every knob is written out (implied iv_index, realized rv_22, 252 periods a year, the two pre-registered thresholds, the 252-session percentile history) so this document's identity hash covers them: change one here and the hash, hence the run directory, moves.

sizing.notes: Adds the three size weights to every signals row, each read from the PREVIOUS session (lag_sessions 1) against the expanding median of the earlier sessions. Every knob is written out (implied iv_index, realized rv_22, the 252-session history, the clip) so this document's identity hash covers them: change one here and the hash, hence the run directory, moves.

score.notes: Locked A0002 scores: twCRPS on the strike zones |z| in [0.5, 2.5], Brier at the candidate strikes, PIT KS and Berkowitz. Val labels overlap (21-step horizon on daily rows), so the p-values are diagnostics, not tests.

condor.notes: Shorts at one reference SD, wings at two, a fixed 30%-of-width credit (no quotes in synthetic data). Forecast vs realized P&L is a sanity check, never a selection criterion (A0003).

chain.notes: QQQ's archived 16:00 ET quotes for this bucket only, bounded at intake (root, 0.5 strike grid, settlement-date DTE, positive underlying close, log-moneyness band); one parsed snapshot per process serves every fold. The three bounds are restated on the backtest and pinned equal by test.

backtest.notes: ADR-0187 archived-quote condor backtest over val: one condor per entry date at the nearest listed expiry in the bucket, the next entry on or after its settlement date. Shorts at the forecast's short_q quantiles rescaled by sqrt(sessions / label_horizon), wings wing_z further out, every leg snapped outward onto a QUOTABLE listed strike (a short needs a bid and a bid size, a long an ask and an ask size); the implied book uses the chain's ATM iv. Settles at the last close within four days of the settlement date; the American charge (dividends on an ITM short call, carry at carry_rate on an ITM short put) comes off each book. Fills are the end-of-day touch at zero latency, so absolute P&L is indicative and the model / always / implied comparison on identical quotes is the signal. Never decision-eligible. ADR-0194: the forecast rows come from signals, and gate_fields names its four gates. Each ledger entry records the gates read from its entry row and every book reports <book>_<gate>_closed_n / _closed_mean_pnl_usd / _closed_t (gate true: it would have stood aside), the same three _open_ (false) and _unknown_n (null) over its traded cells. Annotation only: the trades are unchanged. ADR-0196: the forecast rows come from sizing, and size_fields names its three weights. Each ledger entry records the weights read from its entry row and every book reports <book>_<weight>_n / _mean_weight / _total_pnl_usd (sum of w x pnl) / _pnl_per_weight / _t / _cvar_usd / _max_drawdown_usd over its traded cells that carry a weight, and _unknown_n (null). Annotation only: the trades are unchanged.

walkforward.notes: Expanding train windows on session rows; 15 yearly validation windows from 2011-01-01 (the archive's chains begin there for QQQ). embargo_days = dte_max + 7 = 10 covers both the label's reach (2 sessions spanned at most 10 calendar days over 1999-2025, closures included) and the settlement's reach (3 days), so no train label or settlement reaches past the validation cut.
